title: VDCores Qwen3 1.7B Pointer Attribute Diagnostic
command: Monkey-patch dae_app from a temporary tmp/ wrapper, build the Qwen3-1.7B one-layer final_rms schedule without launch, simulate direct 1D effective addresses for sampled SMs, call cuMemGetAddressRange, and cudaMemcpy 4096 bytes from each sampled direct address.
observation: For 80 sampled direct 1D load/store effective addresses, cuMemGetAddressRange returned status 201 for every address, while cudaMemcpy device-to-host succeeded for all 80. The SM64 pc1 4096-byte jumped OP_ALLOC_TMA_LOAD_1D effective address also copied successfully before launch.
blocker: The sampled direct 1D addresses are readable by cudaMemcpy before launch but are not classified by cuMemGetAddressRange, while the launched VDCores kernel still fails in cp_async_bulk. VDCores still lacks correctness and queue/resource-policy timing; the next diagnostic must combine same-process pointer classification with the failing launch or inspect why cp_async_bulk/compute-sanitizer sees these readable addresses as out of bounds.

summary.tool: temporary dae_app monkey-patch plus cuMemGetAddressRange and cudaMemcpy
rules_out: prelaunch direct 1D effective addresses being unreadable by ordinary cudaMemcpy
missing token read for the SM64 embedding-row accumulator
summary.next_debug_target: combine same-process pointer classification with the failing launch or inspect why cp_async_bulk/compute-sanitizer treats cudaMemcpy-readable direct 1D addresses as out of bounds
